ae_match_explanation: The image shows papules and pustules on the face covering approximately 15% BSA, consistent with Grade 2 acneiform eruption associated with EGFR inhibitor therapy.

ctcae_grade_visual.ctcae_descriptor: Papules and/or pustules covering 10-30% BSA, which may or may not be associated with symptoms of pruritus or tenderness; associated psychosocial impact; limiting instrumental ADL

caveats: In-person clinical assessment required to confirm grade and rule out superinfection.
